# Dialog

A window overlaid on existing content.

- **Import:** `import { Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogOverlay, DialogPortal, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Components
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-dialog--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  Button,
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
  Input,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function DialogExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Dialog>
        <DialogTrigger asChild>
          <Button variant="outline">Edit Profile</Button>
        </DialogTrigger>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Edit profile</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you&apos;re
              done.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 py-4">
            <Input id="name" label="Name" defaultValue="Pedro Duarte" />
            <Input id="username" label="Username" defaultValue="@peduarte" />
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" type="button">
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit">Save changes</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Dialog

Its props are `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Root>`.

- `children`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `open`: `boolean`, optional.
- `defaultOpen`: `boolean`, optional.
- `onOpenChange`: `(open: boolean) => void`, optional.
- `modal`: `boolean`, optional.

## DialogPortal

Its props are `{ children?: React.ReactNode; container?: Element | DocumentFragment | null; forceMount?: true }`.

- `children`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `container`: `Element | DocumentFragment | null`, optional.
- `forceMount`: `true`, optional.

## DialogOverlay

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `Omit<DialogPrimitive.DialogOverlayProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "ref">`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `forceMount`: `true`, optional.

  Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when
  controlling animation with React animation libraries.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## DialogContent

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `Omit<DialogPrimitive.DialogContentProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "ref"> & { portalContainer?: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Portal>["container"] }`.

- `portalContainer`: `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Portal>["container"]`, optional.
- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `forceMount`: `true`, optional.

  Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when
  controlling animation with React animation libraries.

- `onEscapeKeyDown`: `(event: KeyboardEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when the escape key is down.
  Can be prevented.

- `onPointerDownOutside`: `(event: PointerDownOutsideEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when the a `pointerdown` event happens outside of the `DismissableLayer`.
  Can be prevented.

- `onFocusOutside`: `(event: FocusOutsideEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when the focus moves outside of the `DismissableLayer`.
  Can be prevented.

- `onInteractOutside`: `(event: PointerDownOutsideEvent | FocusOutsideEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when an interaction happens outside the `DismissableLayer`.
  Specifically, when a `pointerdown` event happens outside or focus moves outside of it.
  Can be prevented.

- `onOpenAutoFocus`: `FocusScopeProps['onMountAutoFocus']`, optional.

  Event handler called when auto-focusing on open.
  Can be prevented.

- `onCloseAutoFocus`: `FocusScopeProps['onUnmountAutoFocus']`, optional.

  Event handler called when auto-focusing on close.
  Can be prevented.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
